findings.reason: §3's done-when (2) requires every census reader of a COCOS-dependent quantity to take it through the §2 entry point, so a node will go looking for a sourcemap declaration on the MAST route that does not exist and will rewire or wrongly certify the wrong module (`mast_solve_inputs.py` is a separate reader, reached from the parity chain and solve-inputs tests, not from `from_mast`); naming `mast_efit.py` as the boundary, or saying the MAST EFIT frame read stays on its existing `TOTAL_FLUX_FACTOR` path, is what makes the claim checkable.
findings.text: §3 says "The MAST read translates COCOS 3 to COCOS 17 through the sourcemap's declared conversion, as `mast_solve_inputs.py` already declares it", yet `from_mast` is fed by `mast_source()` (`scripts/reconstructed_plasma_source/measure.py:29-37`) from `nova.media.sources.mast_efit.read_pulse`/`read_frame`, and no caller of `from_mast` imports `mast_solve_inputs`; `read_frame` (mast_efit.py:101-135) applies only `TOTAL_FLUX_FACTOR` from `nova.equilibrium.convention` and carries no `SourceSignal`/`source_convention` declaration

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `nova/imas/plasma_source.py::PlasmaSlice.prescribe` (guard at plasma_source.py:70-77), `tests/test_plasma_source.py::test_mast_flipped_psi_is_refused` (line 60), `nova/imas/extrapolate.py` lines 301 and 345, `magnetics.py::Magnetics.flux_loop`, `io_magnetics.py::Magnetics` and `mast_solve_inputs.py` all exist as named.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §3's done-when states measurable clauses (from_imas prescribes CORSICA 130506/6 and DINA 105069/3, refuses 105014/1 and 105013/1 each with its contradicting digit; the re-pointed tests pass by delta in fresh processes) and declares both a literal negative control (bypass the translation and CORSICA 130506/6 is refused again) and a positive control for its search; note only that clause (1)'s "stays green as written" for `test_mast_flipped_psi_is_refused` sits in mild tension with line 59's "re-expressed ... refused by name", which could change the message the test matches on — it is self-caught by the clause itself, so no finding.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §3 names no scratch path; its record is the §1 census file `docs/research/dd-cocos-census.html` and the plan's evidence fragment, both durable and git-tracked.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §3 introduces no plan labels, stage names or ticket numbers, and its prose states mechanism (σ_Bp, the COCOS digits) rather than a tracker entry.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §3 names `mast_solve_inputs.py` as the module declaring the MAST read's COCOS 3 to 17 conversion, but that module is not on the `PlasmaSource.from_mast` path; the frame reader `from_mast` actually consumes is `nova/media/sources/mast_efit.py`, which rescales flux only by `TOTAL_FLUX_FACTOR` and declares no sourcemap conversion.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §3 carries one deliverable, the readers moving onto the §2 translator; the three re-pointed tests and the re-run of §1's search are evidence for that one goal, not a second one.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §3 declares `data-links="dd-cocos-ingest#s2"` and the meta block's `plan-section-depends-on` carries `s3: [s2]`, which is the edge §3 needs (the readers go through the §2 translator).
